LibRaw 0.22.1 Release

This is bugfix-only release with these commits included:

b59a388 Limit strcat space in hassy model manipulation

c0f89f3 Version increment; shlib increment: internal ABI has changed

69d6cfa check panasonic enc8 tile width against image width

e36b26a CR3 parser: zero all buffers before fread

5cc71db skip memory allocation checks for OWN_ALLOC decoders; DNG SDK glue: check for memory limits; raw2image()/dcraw_process() - check for int16 source data present

fcbad80 Check for correct bayer pattern, pass incorect ones to vng_interpolate

53365ec parse_rollei: zero input string before fgets

2468614 Nikon padded/12bit: no need to calculate padded row size before final raw_width adjustment

aa4458e Fix for data size calculation integer overflow in float/deflated DNG loader (TALOS-2026-2364); Check for read results

c911c9b Fix for TALOS-2026-2363: avoid integer overflow in allocation size calculation. Also: check for EOF in read loop

ac151a8 X3F decoder: implemented hard single allocation limit via LIBRAW_X3F_ALLOC_LIMIT_MB define; allocation size calculation converted to 64 bit arithm; fix for TALOS-2026-2359

b9809e4 Fix for TALOS-2026-2358

75ed2c1 Fix for TALOS-2026-2331

5357bb5 Fix for TALOS-2026-2330

f571e44 Sony YCC decoder: check tile size; add +3 bytes to input buffer to avoid possible overrun in huffman decoder

dae685a FP DNG data limit: perform calculations in 64 bit

20b7125 Add extra huff_coeff item to handle huff_index==17 with known (zero) value, not externally provided tag value

0109312 use %lld format for timestamp parse/print where appropriate

3e24d07 nikon coolscan loader: check for EOF

f98a871 Initialize olympus lensID bits

4484c30 CR3 parser: all file offsets are unsigned/64bit; check current offset against file size

e628ada Add Canon EOS Kiss M2 to camera list

fcb1cc0 Check real color count against filters; do not pass really 4-color images to fbdd or advanced demosaic

95990e5 Use LIBRAW_EXCEPTION instead of own internal in losslessjpeg.h

33479ae zero input string to avoid compare random stack garbage with tag names

cb2fa92 Check for eof in Pentax tag search loop

24ba343 Fuji decoder: initialize allocated buffers
